implemented.desktopBehavior: Authenticated system_config read/patch-only cloud writes with subsequent GET verification. Failed/unverified writes retain a retry patch and never claim saved. Disabled watermark position is 0; valid positions 5/7/8/9. Disabling preserves the last valid position for re-enabling within the current account view. Original input bytes are not passed through an SDR canvas.
